verdict.rationale: The only documented capabilities that act on many items at once are Langfuse's own batch-style features: scheduled Blob Storage Export of large data volumes, experiments run across whole datasets, and LLM-as-a-judge evaluators applied automatically to production traffic. A hands-on user reported the trace retrieval API was 'brutally slow' for bulk scanning and fell back to querying the database directly, which further limits bulk programmatic work. missing for 10: documented select-many bulk actions (bulk delete, tag, score, or add-to-dataset), bulk mutation endpoints in the API/CLI/MCP, performant bulk read access, and independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
